text.text: Payment-service is failing due to PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion and DB timeouts (`DB_CONN_TIMEOUT`, `FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved...`), and the same pod is also crashing with `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` and `OOMKilled`/`CrashLoopBackOff`. The blast radius includes `payment-service`, `postgres-primary`, `api-gateway`, `kubelet`/`kubernetes`, plus secondary auth degradation in `auth-service` and `redis-cache` from Redis session lookup timeouts causing 401s. Overall severity is P1 with immediate user impact on payment submissions and some authenticated requests failing or timing out, including 502/504s from `api-gateway` on `/api/v1/payments`. The single most critical next step is to roll back `payment-service` from `v2.8.4` to `v2.8.3` and immediately relieve pressure on `postgres-primary` while restoring pod memory headroom.

*Issues Identified:*
• *DB_TIMEOUT* on `payment-service, postgres-primary, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *OOM_KILL* on `payment-service, kubelet, kubernetes` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *NETWORK_ERROR* on `api-gateway, payment-service` — P1 (confidence: 89%)
• *AUTH_ERROR* on `auth-service, redis-cache, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 96%)
• *DEPLOY_FAILURE* on `deployment-controller, payment-service, kubernetes` — P2 (confidence: 83%)
